problems.description: Attackers send emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into submitting their login credentials on fake websites.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) across all accounts
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user training and phishing simulation exercises

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing campaigns aimed at specific individuals or roles within an organization to gain access to sensitive information or systems.
risk_reduction: Use threat intelligence to identify targeted campaigns
Limit information exposure on social media and public profiles
Train employees on recognizing personalized phishing attempts

problems.description: Attackers compromise or spoof executive email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive data from employees.
risk_reduction: Verify unusual requests through secondary communication channels
Enable email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Monitor email account activity for anomalies and unauthorized access

problems.description: Use of AI to craft highly convincing and personalized phishing messages at scale, increasing success rates.
risk_reduction: Deploy advanced email analysis tools leveraging AI to detect synthetic content
Enhance user awareness training with examples of AI-generated phishing
Implement strict email authentication and anomaly detection

problems.description: Publicly accessible cloud storage buckets exposing sensitive data due to misconfiguration.
risk_reduction: Implement automated configuration scanning and compliance checks
Enforce least privilege access policies
Use cloud provider security posture management (CSPM) tools

problems.description: Attackers compromise software dependencies or update mechanisms to inject malicious code into widely distributed applications.
risk_reduction: Implement software bill of materials (SBOM) and dependency auditing
Use code signing and verify update integrity
Monitor threat intelligence for supply chain indicators

problems.description: Attackers manipulate training data or model inputs to degrade or subvert machine learning model performance.
risk_reduction: Validate and sanitize training datasets
Use robust ML algorithms resistant to adversarial inputs
Monitor model behavior for anomalies

problems.description: Attackers exfiltrate data before encrypting systems and threaten to release sensitive information if ransom is not paid.
risk_reduction: Implement robust data backup and recovery plans
Use network segmentation and data loss prevention (DLP) tools
Conduct regular ransomware simulation exercises
